newsitem.title: POLAND: SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE KREDYT, PBI MERGER.
newsitem.headline: SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE KREDYT, PBI MERGER.

text.p: Shareholders of Polish Kredyt Bank SA approved on Thursday the bank's merger with the Polish Investment Bank SA (PBI) through transferring PBI's assets to Kredyt Bank, Kredyt Bank said in a statement on Thursday.
"Kredyt Bank SA merges with Polish Investment Bank SA through a take-over of all PBI's assets by Kredyt Bank," the statement said.

It said that the merger would take place without raising Kredyt's share capital or a share issue in exchange for PBI's assets. It also said Kredyt Bank planned to complete the merger with PBI by November 30 this year.
Kredyt Bank ended 1996 with a capital of 219 million zlotys, while PBI ended the year with a capital of 197.1 million zlotys.
As a result of the merger, the newly formed bank, called Kredyt Bank PBI SA, will be among Poland's 10 largest banks.
